title: Polish Open Science Platform
main_text: Polish Open Science Platform We support the development of Polish science and innovation by offering modern tools and access to unique research data. All Resources Datasets Publications Software Services Data sources Providers Interoperability Guidelines Browse Exact match What can you explore on our platform? Explore the catalogue Find the resources you need quickly and easily. Simple and intuitive discovery Filters tailored to your needs Instant access to key information Browse resources Request resources and track your orders Request and manage resources online. Less paperwork, more control in one place. Easy ordering Order management Project managment in one place Learn how ordering works Provide your resources and reach a wider audience Share your resources with the European research community and manage requests in one place. Service and offer management Requests and ordering Visibility across Europe Contact our team Our Data Sources Our data sources bring together trusted research outputs, institutional repositories, and verified scientific datasets in one connected ecosystem. Access reliable, high-quality data from across Poland and Europe ready to discover, reuse, and build upon. Browse Data Sources Slide 1 of 4 ROHub ROHub ROHub enables the management, sharing and preservation of research artefacts related to a particular investigation/research challenge as a single information unit through the Research Object (RO) concept and model. Poznan Supercomputing and Networking Center Slide 2 of 4 Bridge of Knowledge Open Research Data Catalog The nature of the ‘Bridge of Data’ project is to design and build a platform that allows collecting, searching, analyzing and sharing open research data and to provide it with unique data collected from the three most important Pomeranian universities Gdańsk University of Technology Slide 3 of 4 RepOD Repository for Open Data RepOD is the first Polish repository for open research data. All researchers, regardless of affiliation and academic discipline, can create a free account and start sharing data produced, collected, or described during research activities. Interdisciplinary Centre for Mathematical and Computational Modelling, University of Warsaw Slide 4 of 4 Oceanographic Data and Information System eCUDO.pl The eCUDO.pl project is created by a consortium of Project partners. These are research units, scientific institutes and universities whose scientific activity focuses on the area of knowledge related to the seas and oceans. Institute of Oceanology Polish Academy of Sciences Previous Next Work with data Within distributed infrastructures and collaborate on research data across infrastructures Work with shared research data in one environment. Upload files, manage access, and collaborate on the same data across providers and compute infrastructures. Shared data spaces Distributed data replication Team collaboration Sign-in to workspace Related Initiatives EOSC Beyond EOSC Beyond is a project developed within the European Open Science Cloud framework to strengthen collaboration among researchers across Europe. It introduces new capabilities to the EOSC Core services and helps research service providers access, integrate, and share resources more effectively. eosc.gov.pl EOSC.gov.pl is an initiative of the Polish EOSC partnership that supports the development of open science in Poland. It provides information on national EOSC-related activities and serves as a space for sharing experiences and good practices among institutions involved in open science. EOSC Association EOSC Association brings together institutions and organisations committed to building an open scientific ecosystem in Europe. It supports collaboration, common standards, and the development of sustainable infrastructure that improves access to research data, tools, and services. EOSC Node Poland Learn more about the EOSC Node Poland and its role in providing a FAIR digital research environment for researchers, integrating national digital resources and services into EOSC. About eosc.pl The Polish Open Science Platform is part of the European Open Science Cloud, which supports open access to research resources across Europe. As a national EOSC node, the platform helps researchers access data, publications, and infrastructure for advanced research and international collaboration. Become a provider Ready to share your resources? We are here to help. Join the EOSC ecosystem and make your services, data, and tools visible to the European research community. Our team supports you throughout the onboarding process. Contact our team [removed_______________] at the 9th World Esperanto Congress in Bern, 1913. Author: Unknown. Source: Bildarchiv Austria. License: Public domain . Partners

children.main_text: Acceptable Use Policy and Conditions of Use This Acceptable Use Policy and Conditions of Use (“AUP”) defines the rules and conditions that govern your access to and use (including transmission, processing, and storage of data) of the resources and services (“Services”) as granted by the ACC Cyfronet AGH for the purpose of the Search Service platform (hereinafter referred to as "Website"), where User can search through a variety of resources, including: publications, data, software, services, and trainings. Users should read, understand and accept this AUP when creating an account on the Website or using any of the services provided via this Website. If a given user has not done this, or does not agree with the terms set out in this document, that user should not create an account on the Website and should not make use of any of the services provided via this Website. By accepting this AUP, the registered User, enters into agreement with ACC Cyfronet AGH, made up by the contents of these terms, in order to regulate the user’s access and use of the Website. User who accept these AUP hereby represent and warrant that: You accept to be bound by these AUP, as registered Website user – either individually, or in representation of an organization; You are capable, under the terms of the applicable law, to be legally bound by and comply with these AUP – in particular, whenever a you create an account as a representative of an organization, that you warrant to have been expressly and validly authorized by that organization to do so, or to otherwise be a legitimate representative of that organization under the applicable law; You shall only use the Services in a manner consistent with the purposes and limitations described above; you shall show consideration towards other users including by not causing harm to the Services; you have an obligation to collaborate in the resolution of issues arising from your use of the Services. You shall only use the Services for lawful purposes and not breach, attempt to breach, nor circumvent administrative or security controls. You shall respect intellectual property and confidentiality agreements. You shall protect your access credentials (e.g. passwords, private keys or multi-factor tokens); no intentional sharing is permitted. You shall keep your registered information correct and up to date. You shall promptly report known or suspected security breaches, credential compromise or misuse to the security contact stated below; and report any compromised credentials to the relevant issuing authorities. Reliance on the Services shall only be to the extent specified by any applicable service level agreements listed below. Use without such agreements is at your own risk. Your personal data will be processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy of the EOSC Search Service. Your use of the Services may be restricted or suspended, for administrative, operational, or security reasons, without prior notice and without compensation. If you violate these rules, you may be liable for the consequences, which may include your account being suspended and a report being made to your home organisation or to law enforcement. Services provided via the Website: Access to services provided via Website is, in part, restricted to registered users - although some Services are open to all Website users. The creation of an account and access to the Website is free of charge. Registered members The Website is intended to allow individuals to become part of the Website community and use the EOSC Search Service solutions. In particular, by creating a registered account, users will be able to become actively involved in EOSC Search Service work and receive personalized recommendations based on the User's scientific interests and activity and on the Website. Newsletters and communications The ACC Cyfronet AGH will include members of EOSC Search Service within specific mailing lists, to ensure that those members are kept updated regarding important news and events related to the Website’s scope, by sending out informative newsletters and other communications to registered users (unless they opt-out of this). Events EOSC Search Service may organize meetings for its community of registered users, which take place in different places around Europe and beyond, seeking to bring together a unique community of research data practitioners and industry and policy stakeholders to pursue the specific objectives of EOSC Search Service . Via Website, registered users are able to sign-up to attend events and webinars for free or at a cost (paid via an external payment processor). More information on Events is available at: eosc.pl User support Any questions concerning Website activities in general can be addressed to the EOSC Search Service via helpdesk. Registered users can address questions specifically referring to the operation and use of the Website by creating the ticket in EOSC Helpdesk. Copyright / Intellectual Property Users of the Website may download or print copies of any and all materials on the Website for personal use. None of the information on this Website may be copied, distributed or transmitted in any way for commercial use. For any materials downloaded from this Website, source and references must be acknowledged. The administrative and security contact for this AUP is: XXXXX@eosc.pl . The privacy statements are located at: Privacy Policy of the EOSC Search Service . Liability The material on this Website is provided for general information only. ACC Cyfronet AGH makes no representations or warranties as to the accuracy or completeness of any materials and information incorporated thereto and contained on this Website. ACC Cyfronet AGH has a policy of continuous improvement of its communication and reserves the right to make improvements or changes to the online content without notice. The use of the material (or any information incorporated thereto), in whole or in part, contained in this Website is the user’s sole responsibility. ACC Cyfronet AGH disclaims any liability for any damages whatsoever including, without limitation, direct, indirect, incidental and/or consequential damages resulting from access to the website and use of the materials provided therein. ACC Cyfronet AGH makes no representations about websites accessed through the EOSC Search Service which are not maintained, controlled or created by ACC Cyfronet AGH. Cyfronet does not endorse these sites and is not responsible for their content.

children.main_text: User Access Policy of EOSC.pl Platform Last updated: July 2025 The EOSC.pl Platform, available at https://eosc.pl/ (hereinafter referred to as "Site" or "Application") comprises two main functionalities: one for users who browse and access research services and resources, and one for organisations and providers who register and onboard their services (e.g., computing services, repositories, training tools). This Privacy Notice outlines how personal data is collected, used, and protected across both functionalities, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and related EU law. We follow these key principles: We collect only the minimum necessary personal data We limit sharing to what is legally or operationally necessary We provide clear options regarding data use We protect your data with appropriate security measures This Privacy Notice describes the policies applied to the personal information collected through the platform website, or when the platform communicates with its users ("you" or "user"), and the choices available to you. "Personal Information" means any data that relates to an identified or identifiable person, under Article 4(1) GDPR. The platform offers a search and discovery feature that allows users to browse scientific services and digital resources, such as publications, datasets, software, tools, and training materials. Users are provided with a personalised search interface, including filters and categories tailored to improve relevance and user experience. The platform also enables organisations and service providers to register and onboard their resources, making them discoverable and accessible to end users through the catalogue. Data Controller The Data Controller responsible for processing your data on the EOSC.pl platform is: ACC Cyfronet AGH Nawojki 11 30-950 Kraków, Poland Email: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl 1. Your consent By using the platform, you acknowledge this Privacy Notice. Where required by law (e.g., for analytics cookies or profiling), we will request your explicit consent before processing begins. 2. Scope This Privacy Notice applies solely to personal information that is collected and processed through the EOSC.pl platform or through any electronic communications initiated via the platform. It does not apply to third-party websites, services, or tools that may be linked from or integrated into the platform. The platform does not endorse, nor is it responsible for the content, terms, or privacy practices of these third-party websites. Any personal data you provide on third-party websites is subject to their respective privacy policies and terms. We encourage you to review these carefully before proceeding. 3. Personal data we collect Legal basis for processing: We process personal data under the following legal bases, as defined in Article 6 of the GDPR: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) , for providing access to platform features and services Compliance with legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)) , particularly for EU-funded project reporting Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) , for platform security, usage analytics, and user experience improvements Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) , where required for specific optional processing (e.g., cookies, newsletter) The data we collect The EOSC.pl Platform manages different types of personal data, all in compliance with applicable European data protection laws. Personal data concerning the user is collected and processed to enable the delivery of services and functionalities offered via the platform. This includes features aimed at: enabling users to browse and access scientific services and resources, and allowing provider organisations to register and onboard services into the platform. The data is collected for the following purposes: service access, user profile management, analytics, support communication, tag and metadata management, displaying external content, and system security. Depending on your interaction with the platform (either as a user or a service provider), the following types of personal data may be collected and processed by the platform, either directly or via third-party integrations: Cookies and usage data First name, last name Email address Affiliation/organisation name Country of origin Federated login attributes, such as your name, email address, organisation affiliation, and a unique user ID used for account recognition User typology (e.g. researcher, citizen, provider, educator) Reason for accessing EOSC services (if submitted voluntarily) Information on accessed or ordered services Messages and communication with the support team Order Management functionality For users who interact with the service ordering workflow, additional personal data may be processed, including: Details of the service order, such as descriptions, configuration parameters, or project references User identifiers and roles within the order flow Organisation and project affiliations Technical contact details and correspondence related to service requests Messages exchanged between users and providers as part of order handling and support This data is collected as part of delivering requested services, tracking progress, and enabling communication between involved parties. Data voluntarily supplied by the user The platform is designed to allow for anonymous browsing in most areas. However, access to personalised features (e.g., service ordering or provider registration) requires login and, in some cases, completion of a user profile. In such cases, the following data may be voluntarily submitted: Contact details (name, email, institution) Service metadata (for providers) Descriptions of use cases or projects Providing this data is optional, but necessary to access specific features. Consent may be withdrawn at any time, although this may disable the corresponding functionality. Service and resource metadata When providers onboard the resources and services, the platform stores and processes service descriptions and metadata, structured according to a standardised schema. This includes: Basic information: resource ID, name, description, provider identity Marketing materials: target users, promotional texts, multimedia assets Classification: scientific domains, categories Geographic and language availability Public contact details for user support Maturity levels (e.g., TRL, release version, lifecycle phase) Relations to other resources within EOSC Project and funding references Operational information: terms of use, helpdesk links, support SLA Access, ordering, and usage constraints Financial model or pricing details (if applicable) This metadata is published to the platform's catalogue and may be publicly accessible, except for specific operational fields reserved for internal management. Platform usage analytics The platform collects aggregated data on how users interact with services and resources. This includes: Anonymised or pseudonymised usage events (e.g., page views, searches, downloads) Search terms and selected filters Browsing history across sessions (if logged in) Resource engagement statistics (e.g., views, clicks, interactions) This data is used to: Provide personalised recommendations (where applicable) Generate aggregated statistics for platform improvement Improve resource discoverability No sensitive data or behavioural profiling is performed beyond what is required to improve relevance and user experience. Users may object to this processing. Cookies and tracking technologies Cookies and similar tracking technologies are used for: Session management and login authentication Remembering user preferences Usage analytics Displaying content from embedded third-party platforms (e.g., video, charts) We use cookies and third-party tools to support core features and improve your experience. Where required by law, we ask for your consent. Data retention We retain personal data only as long as needed for platform operation, or as required by legal obligations or project agreements (e.g., retention for 3 years after project completion). The User can always request that the Data Controller suspend or remove the data. Third-party data Users are responsible for any third-party personal data that they provide (e.g., in uploaded service descriptions or messages) and confirm that they have the right to do so. The platform assumes that such data has been shared lawfully. 4. Data storage, processing, and retention Data location All personal data processed via the EOSC.pl platform is managed and stored by ACC Cyfronet AGH, located in Kraków, Poland. Data processing takes place within the European Union, and no data is currently transferred outside the EU/EEA. For any inquiries, please contact: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl Log information The platform automatically collects general technical data during your visit. This includes: IP address Browser type and version Device type and screen resolution Operating system Pages visited and time spent Referring website (if any) Actions performed on the site This information is used for security, platform optimisation, and usage statistics. Data is anonymised or pseudonymised where applicable. Duration of processing Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to: provide access to the platform fulfill service requests or communications comply with legal obligations Where data is collected in the context of funded projects, it may be retained for the project duration plus an additional 3 years, as required by standard EU grant terms. You may request deletion or restriction of your data at any time. Children's data The platform is not intended for use by children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we become aware that such data has been collected, it will be promptly deleted. 5. Use of personal data Personal data is used for the following purposes: Fulfilling your requests - Responding to inquiries, managing user accounts, and processing service access or usage Platform operation - Managing user sessions, authentication, security, and the availability of platform features Usage analytics - Collecting anonymised data to improve the platform and understand how users interact with services Personalisation (if applicable) - Offering search suggestions or resource recommendations based on your previous activity. This may involve basic profiling but does not include automated decision-making with legal effects Communication and support - Responding to your questions or support messages sent via the platform Legal compliance and safeguarding - Ensuring compliance with EU law and protecting the technical and legal integrity of the platform 6. Disclosure of personal data At this time, ACC Cyfronet AGH is the sole entity responsible for the processing of personal data on the EOSC.pl platform. There are no external data processors involved. Data is not shared with third parties unless required by law or you explicitly request a service that involves external communication (e.g., contacting a provider). Cyfronet takes appropriate technical and organisational measures to prevent unauthorised access, modification, or disclosure of your data. 7. Law enforcement and legal obligations We may disclose your personal data to law enforcement or other competent authorities: If required by law to comply with legal processes to prevent or investigate misuse of the platform or to protect the rights and safety of users or the service provider Unless prohibited by applicable law, we will inform you when such a disclosure occurs. 8. Your data protection rights Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data: Right of access (Art. 15) - You may request access to the personal data we hold about you Right to rectification (Art. 16) - You can request that inaccurate or incomplete data be corrected Right to erasure (Art. 17) - You can ask us to delete your data, unless legal grounds prevent us Right to restrict processing (Art. 18) - You may request temporary suspension of processing Right to object (Art. 21) - You may object to processing based on our legitimate interests Right to data portability (Art. 20) - You have the right to receive your data in a portable format, where applicable Requests can be submitted via: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl You also have the right to complain to a supervisory authority, such as the Polish Data Protection Office. 9. Security We apply technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data from loss, misuse, unauthorised access, alteration, or destruction. These measures are consistent with industry standards and include data access controls, secure infrastructure, and regular security assessments. However, no system is completely secure. We cannot guarantee the security of: our servers at all times data transmission over the internet (e.g. between your device and our platform) unencrypted communication channels such as email If you contact us by email, please note that messages are usually transmitted as plain text and may be vulnerable to interception. If your message includes sensitive or confidential information, we recommend contacting us first to arrange a secure communication method. 10. Jurisdiction and access responsibility This platform is operated under the laws and jurisdiction of the Republic of Poland and the European Union. We do not represent that the services are appropriate or available for use in all geographic locations. By accessing the platform from outside the EU, you do so on your own initiative and are responsible for compliance with any local laws or regulations applicable to your use. We reserve the right to restrict access to the platform in certain countries or regions, at our discretion. 11. Inquiries and complaints If you have questions, concerns, or complaints about this Privacy Notice or our data handling practices, you can contact us at: Email: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl Data Protection Lead ACC Cyfronet AGH Nawojki 11 30-950 Kraków, Poland We are committed to responding promptly and addressing legitimate concerns in line with applicable data protection law. 12. Updates to the Privacy Notice We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time, particularly in response to: legal or regulatory changes new features or data processing activities feedback from users or authorities If we make significant changes, we will provide a clear notice on the platform. Changes take effect upon publication, unless otherwise stated. Continued use of the platform following an update implies your acceptance of the revised terms. You may object to changes by contacting us at XXXXX@cyfronet.pl . If you do so, we will stop processing your personal data under the new terms, but this may limit your ability to continue using certain services. 13. children.full_text: About Browse resources Work with data Login Go back to resource discovery service User Access Policy of EOSC.pl Platform Last updated: July 2025 The EOSC.pl Platform, available at https://eosc.pl/ (hereinafter referred to as "Site" or "Application") comprises two main functionalities: one for users who browse and access research services and resources, and one for organisations and providers who register and onboard their services (e.g., computing services, repositories, training tools). This Privacy Notice outlines how personal data is collected, used, and protected across both functionalities, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and related EU law. We follow these key principles: We collect only the minimum necessary personal data We limit sharing to what is legally or operationally necessary We provide clear options regarding data use We protect your data with appropriate security measures This Privacy Notice describes the policies applied to the personal information collected through the platform website, or when the platform communicates with its users ("you" or "user"), and the choices available to you. "Personal Information" means any data that relates to an identified or identifiable person, under Article 4(1) GDPR. The platform offers a search and discovery feature that allows users to browse scientific services and digital resources, such as publications, datasets, software, tools, and training materials. Users are provided with a personalised search interface, including filters and categories tailored to improve relevance and user experience. The platform also enables organisations and service providers to register and onboard their resources, making them discoverable and accessible to end users through the catalogue. Data Controller The Data Controller responsible for processing your data on the EOSC.pl platform is: ACC Cyfronet AGH Nawojki 11 30-950 Kraków, Poland Email: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl 1. Your consent By using the platform, you acknowledge this Privacy Notice. Where required by law (e.g., for analytics cookies or profiling), we will request your explicit consent before processing begins. 2. Scope This Privacy Notice applies solely to personal information that is collected and processed through the EOSC.pl platform or through any electronic communications initiated via the platform. It does not apply to third-party websites, services, or tools that may be linked from or integrated into the platform. The platform does not endorse, nor is it responsible for the content, terms, or privacy practices of these third-party websites. Any personal data you provide on third-party websites is subject to their respective privacy policies and terms. We encourage you to review these carefully before proceeding. 3. Personal data we collect Legal basis for processing: We process personal data under the following legal bases, as defined in Article 6 of the GDPR: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) , for providing access to platform features and services Compliance with legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)) , particularly for EU-funded project reporting Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) , for platform security, usage analytics, and user experience improvements Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) , where required for specific optional processing (e.g., cookies, newsletter) The data we collect The EOSC.pl Platform manages different types of personal data, all in compliance with applicable European data protection laws. Personal data concerning the user is collected and processed to enable the delivery of services and functionalities offered via the platform. This includes features aimed at: enabling users to browse and access scientific services and resources, and allowing provider organisations to register and onboard services into the platform. The data is collected for the following purposes: service access, user profile management, analytics, support communication, tag and metadata management, displaying external content, and system security. Depending on your interaction with the platform (either as a user or a service provider), the following types of personal data may be collected and processed by the platform, either directly or via third-party integrations: Cookies and usage data First name, last name Email address Affiliation/organisation name Country of origin Federated login attributes, such as your name, email address, organisation affiliation, and a unique user ID used for account recognition User typology (e.g. researcher, citizen, provider, educator) Reason for accessing EOSC services (if submitted voluntarily) Information on accessed or ordered services Messages and communication with the support team Order Management functionality For users who interact with the service ordering workflow, additional personal data may be processed, including: Details of the service order, such as descriptions, configuration parameters, or project references User identifiers and roles within the order flow Organisation and project affiliations Technical contact details and correspondence related to service requests Messages exchanged between users and providers as part of order handling and support This data is collected as part of delivering requested services, tracking progress, and enabling communication between involved parties. Data voluntarily supplied by the user The platform is designed to allow for anonymous browsing in most areas. However, access to personalised features (e.g., service ordering or provider registration) requires login and, in some cases, completion of a user profile. In such cases, the following data may be voluntarily submitted: Contact details (name, email, institution) Service metadata (for providers) Descriptions of use cases or projects Providing this data is optional, but necessary to access specific features. Consent may be withdrawn at any time, although this may disable the corresponding functionality. Service and resource metadata When providers onboard the resources and services, the platform stores and processes service descriptions and metadata, structured according to a standardised schema. This includes: Basic information: resource ID, name, description, provider identity Marketing materials: target users, promotional texts, multimedia assets Classification: scientific domains, categories Geographic and language availability Public contact details for user support Maturity levels (e.g., TRL, release version, lifecycle phase) Relations to other resources within EOSC Project and funding references Operational information: terms of use, helpdesk links, support SLA Access, ordering, and usage constraints Financial model or pricing details (if applicable) This metadata is published to the platform's catalogue and may be publicly accessible, except for specific operational fields reserved for internal management. Platform usage analytics The platform collects aggregated data on how users interact with services and resources. This includes: Anonymised or pseudonymised usage events (e.g., page views, searches, downloads) Search terms and selected filters Browsing history across sessions (if logged in) Resource engagement statistics (e.g., views, clicks, interactions) This data is used to: Provide personalised recommendations (where applicable) Generate aggregated statistics for platform improvement Improve resource discoverability No sensitive data or behavioural profiling is performed beyond what is required to improve relevance and user experience. Users may object to this processing. Cookies and tracking technologies Cookies and similar tracking technologies are used for: Session management and login authentication Remembering user preferences Usage analytics Displaying content from embedded third-party platforms (e.g., video, charts) We use cookies and third-party tools to support core features and improve your experience. Where required by law, we ask for your consent. Data retention We retain personal data only as long as needed for platform operation, or as required by legal obligations or project agreements (e.g., retention for 3 years after project completion). The User can always request that the Data Controller suspend or remove the data. Third-party data Users are responsible for any third-party personal data that they provide (e.g., in uploaded service descriptions or messages) and confirm that they have the right to do so. The platform assumes that such data has been shared lawfully. 4. Data storage, processing, and retention Data location All personal data processed via the EOSC.pl platform is managed and stored by ACC Cyfronet AGH, located in Kraków, Poland. Data processing takes place within the European Union, and no data is currently transferred outside the EU/EEA. For any inquiries, please contact: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl Log information The platform automatically collects general technical data during your visit. This includes: IP address Browser type and version Device type and screen resolution Operating system Pages visited and time spent Referring website (if any) Actions performed on the site This information is used for security, platform optimisation, and usage statistics. Data is anonymised or pseudonymised where applicable. Duration of processing Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to: provide access to the platform fulfill service requests or communications comply with legal obligations Where data is collected in the context of funded projects, it may be retained for the project duration plus an additional 3 years, as required by standard EU grant terms. You may request deletion or restriction of your data at any time. Children's data The platform is not intended for use by children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we become aware that such data has been collected, it will be promptly deleted. 5. Use of personal data Personal data is used for the following purposes: Fulfilling your requests - Responding to inquiries, managing user accounts, and processing service access or usage Platform operation - Managing user sessions, authentication, security, and the availability of platform features Usage analytics - Collecting anonymised data to improve the platform and understand how users interact with services Personalisation (if applicable) - Offering search suggestions or resource recommendations based on your previous activity. This may involve basic profiling but does not include automated decision-making with legal effects Communication and support - Responding to your questions or support messages sent via the platform Legal compliance and safeguarding - Ensuring compliance with EU law and protecting the technical and legal integrity of the platform 6. Disclosure of personal data At this time, ACC Cyfronet AGH is the sole entity responsible for the processing of personal data on the EOSC.pl platform. There are no external data processors involved. Data is not shared with third parties unless required by law or you explicitly request a service that involves external communication (e.g., contacting a provider). Cyfronet takes appropriate technical and organisational measures to prevent unauthorised access, modification, or disclosure of your data. 7. Law enforcement and legal obligations We may disclose your personal data to law enforcement or other competent authorities: If required by law to comply with legal processes to prevent or investigate misuse of the platform or to protect the rights and safety of users or the service provider Unless prohibited by applicable law, we will inform you when such a disclosure occurs. 8. Your data protection rights Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data: Right of access (Art. 15) - You may request access to the personal data we hold about you Right to rectification (Art. 16) - You can request that inaccurate or incomplete data be corrected Right to erasure (Art. 17) - You can ask us to delete your data, unless legal grounds prevent us Right to restrict processing (Art. 18) - You may request temporary suspension of processing Right to object (Art. 21) - You may object to processing based on our legitimate interests Right to data portability (Art. 20) - You have the right to receive your data in a portable format, where applicable Requests can be submitted via: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl You also have the right to complain to a supervisory authority, such as the Polish Data Protection Office. 9. Security We apply technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data from loss, misuse, unauthorised access, alteration, or destruction. These measures are consistent with industry standards and include data access controls, secure infrastructure, and regular security assessments. However, no system is completely secure. We cannot guarantee the security of: our servers at all times data transmission over the internet (e.g. between your device and our platform) unencrypted communication channels such as email If you contact us by email, please note that messages are usually transmitted as plain text and may be vulnerable to interception. If your message includes sensitive or confidential information, we recommend contacting us first to arrange a secure communication method. 10. Jurisdiction and access responsibility This platform is operated under the laws and jurisdiction of the Republic of Poland and the European Union. We do not represent that the services are appropriate or available for use in all geographic locations. By accessing the platform from outside the EU, you do so on your own initiative and are responsible for compliance with any local laws or regulations applicable to your use. We reserve the right to restrict access to the platform in certain countries or regions, at our discretion. 11. Inquiries and complaints If you have questions, concerns, or complaints about this Privacy Notice or our data handling practices, you can contact us at: Email: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl Data Protection Lead ACC Cyfronet AGH Nawojki 11 30-950 Kraków, Poland We are committed to responding promptly and addressing legitimate concerns in line with applicable data protection law. 12. Updates to the Privacy Notice We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time, particularly in response to: legal or regulatory changes new features or data processing activities feedback from users or authorities If we make significant changes, we will provide a clear notice on the platform. Changes take effect upon publication, unless otherwise stated. Continued use of the platform following an update implies your acceptance of the revised terms. You may object to changes by contacting us at XXXXX@cyfronet.pl . If you do so, we will stop processing your personal data under the new terms, but this may limit your ability to continue using certain services. 13. Contact Us For questions about this Privacy Notice or our privacy and data protection practices, please contact: ACC Cyfronet AGH Nawojki 11 30-950 Kraków, Poland Email: XXXXX@cyfronet.pl Helpdesk Back to the top For users Browse resources Your projects Documentation For providers Backoffice Become a provider Marketplace API Partners National Science Centre ACC Cyfronet AGH Gdańsk University of Technology University of Warsaw Institute of Oceanology PAN Contact contact@eosc.pl XXXXX@eosc.pl support@eosc.pl Copyright 2026 | All rights reserved | User Access Policy | Acceptable Use Policy | Download Logo
